description: Koyeb service definition for the Wayfarer Go API. Create the service with the Koyeb CLI/API using these values. Secrets are referenced, never embedded.

migration_job.description: Run once per deploy before shifting traffic to the new revision, or as a Koyeb job.

notes: Vercel must reach the API over HTTPS, so expose the Koyeb service endpoint; every /v1 route requires the shared X-Internal-Token.
Set INTERNAL_API_TOKEN to the same 32+ character random value in Vercel and on Koyeb.
Never put the Koyeb origin or token in browser code or NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables; the browser only talks to /api on Vercel.
Create the database and run the migration job before the first web deployment.
Maps need no API key: OSM.de street tiles and Esri World Imagery satellite tiles are loaded by the browser.
Rotate any database credential or Gmail app password that has been pasted into a chat or committed. Use a Koyeb secret for SMTP_PASSWORD.
